responsibilities: Design, build and optimise scalable data models within a modern cloud data platform.
Develop new data solutions supporting upcoming products and business initiatives.
Review and improve existing data models, focusing on performance, efficiency, cost and maintainability.
Work directly with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Finance and Analytics to understand their challenges and design appropriate solutions.
Contribute to data quality, governance and testing standards within a regulated environment.
Explore opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve engineering practices and delivery.
Work across the wider data ecosystem, gaining exposure to Data Engineering, orchestration and BI.
Collaborate with and support less experienced engineers, sharing knowledge and contributing to technical decisions.
